name: TC-DA — Counselor submits a complete RoW DA application

steps.name: Log in as the student and provide the remaining required documents and signature

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByText('Fill Form Manually', { exact: true }).or(getByText('Complete your Application', { exact: true })).or(getByText('Application Sections', { exact: true })).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'Review your application' })).or(getByText('Submitted for Counsellor Review', { exact: true }))
Wait for selector locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByText('Saige is reviewing your application. Please wait until the review is complete.', { exact: true })

Click locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().locator('#question-anchor-11002').locator('..').getByRole('button', { name: 'Replace signature' }).or(locator('#question-anchor-11002').locator('..').getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add signature' }))
Log in as the counselor and approve the complete application
Click locator('div').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'University of New South Wales', exact: true }) }).filter({ hasText: 'Reviewed' }).last().getByText('Review', { exact: true })

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByText('Fill Form Manually', { exact: true }).or(getByText('Complete your Application', { exact: true })).or(getByText('Application Sections', { exact: true })).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'Review your application' })).or(getByText('Submitted for Counsellor Review', { exact: true }))
Wait for selector locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByText('Saige is reviewing your application. Please wait until the review is complete.', { exact: true })
Scroll into view locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByRole('button', { name: /Submit application|Submit to Counselor\/School review|Submit for Review|Approve and Submit/ })
Click locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByRole('button', { name: /Submit application|Submit to Counselor\/School review|Submit for Review|Approve and Submit/ })

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByText('fix a few things first').or(getByRole('button', { name: /^(Confirm|Submit application|Submit to Counselor\/School review|Submit for Review)$/ }))
Query count locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByRole('button', { name: 'Skip and Submit', exact: true })
Click locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByRole('button', { name: 'Skip and Submit', exact: true })
Click locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByRole('button', { name: /^(Confirm|Submit application|Submit to Counselor\/School review|Submit for Review)$/ })
Verify the application shows as submitted on the student's DA home
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Direct Apply', exact: true }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'What is Direct Apply?', exact: true }))
Expect "toHaveCount" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Direct Apply', exact: true }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'What is Direct Apply?', exact: true }))

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'University of New South Wales', exact: true }) }).filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Status', exact: true }) }).last()
